test_title: PYST 65: SSC GD Constable 2022 - English (Held On : 08 Feb 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution’.**

**__When he ____hand in ____his homework__**, he forgot to give the teacher the last page.

options.text: When he has handed in his homework,
When he handed in his homework,

solution:
The correct answer is** "When he handed in his homework,"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The sentence **"When he hand in his homework, he forgot to give the teacher the last page" **contains a subject-verb agreement error.
 
• The correction involves changing **"hand"** to **"handed"** to ensure agreement between the subject **"he"** and the past tense verb **"handed."**
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.

Correct sentence: ***When he handed in his homework**__, he forgot to give the teacher the last page.*
